_comment: Frozen experiment manifest. Written 2026-10-11. Do not modify until new training run completes.

scope.ten_ambiguity_resolution: 10 = nine routes in current schema. No tenth route exists. Do not invent one.
scope.route_boundary_rule: Use phone_health_check when request spans two or more live-data categories (battery+storage, charging+RAM, etc.) or asks for overall phone condition. Use single-category routes (get_battery_info, get_storage_info, get_device_info) only when the request is unambiguously about that single category. Use answer when no live phone data is needed.
hard_constraints: Do NOT publish reflex-1 or push weights to HuggingFace
Do NOT log eval runs to W&B (only training runs)
Do NOT retrain on the 50-case development suite and call it held-out evidence
Do NOT claim Kotlin AgentDecisionSelector is a complete adapter integration — it is a code seam only
The Clef GGUF cannot do chat completions (no vocabulary logits)
--no-repack is required for Clef. Do not remove this flag
Do NOT load both models simultaneously
data/phone_routing/test.jsonl is held-out — never include in training or calibration

test.status: SEALED — do not open until after candidate selection

initial_trial_splits.note: For the initial existing-data trial, carve 90 validation rows (10/route, stratified) from the 900-row train pool. Remaining 810 rows are training. Calibration and test unchanged.

reflex1_before_retrain.note: 82/90 routed to phone_health_check; 5 routes never chosen

qwen_raw_http_matched.treatment: raw — no chat template, GBNF grammar, /v1/completions
qwen_raw_http_matched.note: This is the WIN TARGET. Retrained reflex-1 must beat 50/90 on this same test set.

historical_baselines.win_condition: retrained_reflex1.accuracy > 0.556 on data/phone_routing/test.jsonl AND retrained_reflex1.a32_latency_s < 36.8 AND no unacceptable regression on typed-decisions/BANKING77/CLINC150

candidate_selection_criteria.primary_metric: Native FastDecisionModel.evaluate validation accuracy for checkpoint selection; phone macro-F1/per-route recall reported separately.
candidate_selection_criteria.threshold_to_open_test: validation macro-F1 >= 0.70 (vs 0.20 for reflex-1 before retrain)

general_retention.typed_decisions: accuracy must not drop more than 5pp from reflex-1 baseline
general_retention.banking77: accuracy must not drop more than 5pp from reflex-1 baseline (pre-retrain: 44.59%)
general_retention.clinc150: accuracy must not drop more than 5pp from reflex-1 baseline (pre-retrain: 47.11%)

candidate_selection_criteria.calibration: ECE after temperature scaling on calibration data < 0.15

resource_budget.a32_latency: mean warm latency < 36.8s (beat Qwen raw baseline)
resource_budget.thermal: no sustained throttling after 10 consecutive requests

selection_order: 1. Use validation macro-F1 to select best checkpoint per run
2. Compare phone-only, general-only, combined runs on validation
4. Calibrate selected checkpoint on calibration data
5. Open test.jsonl once for the selected candidate only
candidate_selection_criteria.warning: Do not declare a win from a small percentage increase on 90 cases without reporting uncertainty. Winning by 1-2 cases is not statistically meaningful.

training_config.checkpoint_selection: Best checkpoint by native validation eval_accuracy; evaluate/save every 20 steps (2 in smoke).

adapter_loading_strategy: RESUME: FastDecisionModel.from_pretrained(reflex1_checkpoint_path) loads backbone + LoRA + head together. Do NOT call get_peft_model again — that would wrap an existing adapter twice. Enable training on existing LoRA parameters directly.

general_data_preparation.status: prepared and CPU-validated; GPU build/smoke pending
general_data_preparation.typed_holdout_prior_use: Original reflex-1 held-out cases, previously evaluated/calibrated; not a fresh test.
